Good For You by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Ready for the ultimate family vacation in the ultimate family oasis? Just a stone's throw away from the vibrant Seaside Town Center, welcome to Good For You, a remarkable 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom dream house, your home base for all things 30A. Ride one of the four bikes to three sparkling community pools! You’re also close to great shops, boutiques, 4-star restaurants, events, shows, and more. Inside, a colorful, cozy living room with a fireplace leads to an open area with a fully equipped kitchen and dining table, providing ample space for your entire group to relax and unwind. A primary suite, king, with a private bath, as well as a guest room, queen, offer comfort and tranquility. Another guest room features a queen bed along with a twin. Plus, each bedroom opens onto a balcony(!), always a great spot for morning coffee.

Even the newly decorated patio is special, another chance to breathe in the fresh Seaside air. Dive into family fun with our Seaside swim and fitness passes, granting you access to not one, not two, but THREE sparkling swimming pools! And for the sporty souls, indulge in the thrill of NFL Redzone or explore the scenic surroundings on bikes! As a special token of our appreciation, a unique gift awaits each guest, adding a touch of warmth and hospitality to your stay. Plus, relish the convenience of pool passes during your week-long stay in the bustling season, and upon request during the serene off-season. Have we thought of everything to make your stay extra special? Come on over and find out. From a cozy gas fireplace to warm your evenings to a tankless Rinnai water heater ensuring your showers are always soothing and refreshing. Your home base for family fun, laughter, and unforgettable memories, ‘Good For You’ is just another way to say, ‘Perfect For The Entire Family’. Enjoy! Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 422 steps (.2 miles) to the beach (West Ruskin Access) - 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths - 1840 sq ft - Charcoal grill - NFL Redzone subscription - Wi-Fi - 4 bikes included - Parking limited to 2 vehicles Overnight: - King in 2nd floor primary bathroom; private bath; balcony; TV - Queen in 2nd floor guest room; jack and jill shared bath; private balcony; TV - 1 queen, 1 twin in 2nd floor guest room; jack and jill shared bath; balcony; TV - Queen sleeper sofa in 1st floor living room; shared hall bath; TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
